info.name: Data AVAX Supply Primary Network Balances API

params.name: blockTimestamp
params.description: An epoch timestamp in seconds. Balance will be calculated at this timestamp.

params.name: addresses
params.description: A comma separated list of X-Chain or P-Chain wallet addresses, starting with "avax"/"fuji", "P-avax"/"P-fuji" or "X-avax"/"X-fuji".

params.name: blockchainId
params.description: A primary network blockchain id or alias.

items.docs:
Gets primary network balances for one of the Primary Network chains for the supplied addresses.

C-Chain balances returned are only the shared atomic memory balance. For EVM balance, use the `/v1/chains/:chainId/addresses/:addressId/balances:getNative` endpoint.
